title: CL4Fire Code-96 and CL4Fire RED duct/pipe insulation
jurisdiction: Canada — national CCMC product evaluation; comparative attachment only, not a Calgary/Edmonton or Alberta project application

facts.text: The CCMC opinion expressly covers products used as an alternative solution for thermal/fire protection of pipes, ventilation ducts and cooking-exhaust ductwork when fire ratings are required.
The opinion classifies Determination of Ratings, Article 3.1.7.1, as Alternative in both NBC 2015 and 2020.
facts.locator: CCMC 14382-R PDF, p. 2, Compliance opinion tables

facts.text: The report says fire ratings and installation limits are based solely on QAI Building Listing Program listings F476-1, F476-3 and F476-4, and requires installation strictly to those listings.
facts.locator: CCMC 14382-R PDF, p. 4, Conditions and limitations

limitations: The evaluation applies only to the uses, listings and installation conditions stated.
It does not decide a building-specific fire rating or approve deviations from the listed system.
